title: Annotating Dimensions of Social Perception in Text: The First Sentence-Level Dataset of Warmth and Competence
reasoning: The paper explicitly evaluates social perception toward 'Religious people' and 'Nonreligious people' (atheists/agnostics) as two of its seven primary annotation targets. Additionally, the 'Trust' dimension is defined as a focus on the personal and moral aspects of targets, specifically evaluating traits like morality, sincerity, and honesty.
